run_notes.zh: Carbon整轮测试及环境排查跨越两天以上；旧Medium批次约47小时40分，此后另按用户授权补测C003。AGY/GCP多次发生服务、断流和交卷错误，具体归因分别留证。
run_notes.en: Carbon testing and environment investigation spanned more than two days. The earlier Medium batch covered about47h40m, followed by the user-authorized extra C003 opportunity. AGY/GCP service, streaming and delivery failures retain their individual evidence.

run_notes.zh: 2026-11-15新加坡时间01:00后授权补测C003：累计物理第7次／有效第6次首次正常交卷，初答及三轮KEEP均AI核验92/92，诊断准确且无回退，轨迹Strict通过。物理第6次为已证实的本地上下文压缩准入故障，单独排除，原ERROR和计数保留。
run_notes.en: The extra C003 opportunity authorized after01:00 Singapore time on2026-11-15 delivered normally on physical7/effective6. A1 and three KEEP rounds each verified92/92; accurate diagnosis and no regression pass the whole Strict trajectory. Physical6 is separately excluded as a proven local native-context compaction admission failure; original ERROR and counters remain retained.

run_notes.zh: 已审Argon/Carbon答卷在部分复杂任务上也暴露出严重的推理与完整交付问题。这些数学判断与API／Harness调用不稳定分别记录；断流本身不能证明推理出错。
run_notes.en: Reviewed Argon/Carbon work also exposes serious reasoning and complete-delivery problems on some complex tasks. These mathematical findings are recorded separately from API and harness instability; a broken stream alone does not establish a reasoning error.

run_notes.zh: 此前Carbon High未形成有效成套成绩；High后续试跑单独留档，不继承Medium答卷或分数。
run_notes.en: Earlier Carbon High runs did not produce a usable complete score set. Subsequent High trials are retained separately and inherit no Medium answers or scores.

run_notes.zh: 最终强收原稿：一项私有手稿题在三次有效尝试后仍无正常交卷，现仅按最后一次截止时封存的完整原稿评审MC，RMC／SMC为0。三项总分为91.78／79.74／64.50；未改规则、未合并前轮内容。
run_notes.en: Final forced collection: One private manuscript task has no normal final after three effective attempts. Only its original work sealed at the final cutoff is reviewed for MC; task RMC/SMC remain0. Totals are91.78/79.74/64.50, with unchanged rules and no cross-attempt source union.

selection_note.zh: 采用用户明确选定的固定快照，并保留首次正常交卷与所有原始请求。个别追加尝试由用户另行指定；原始物理编号与实际有效次数（包括第4／5次）分别留档，不混同、不改写成常规三次以内，也不按得分择优。 本快照另保留物理第7次／有效第6次及其先前全部失败，不将其改写为三次以内。
selection_note.en: This fixed snapshot was explicitly selected by the user. First normal finals and all original requests are retained. Specific additional trials were separately requested. Original physical request IDs and effective attempt counts, including effective attempts4/5, are kept distinct; they are not relabeled as within the ordinary three-attempt limit or selected by score. This snapshot also retains physical7/effective6 and all preceding failures without relabeling them within three attempts.

run_notes.en: This continuation completes non-Lean tasks first, then Lean tasks, with C003 last. Successful pilots are the formal original deliveries; mathematical errors after a normal final never trigger a retry.

run_notes.zh: 一项本地控制器把后继原生MEDIUM请求误当违例，在联网前拒绝；原ERROR及调用记录保留，确证的控制器或TLS握手故障不消耗有效尝试。随后原样保存原生自动变档；未确证为纯系统故障的流读取中断仍保守计次，实际超时和输出耗尽计次。
run_notes.en: A local controller incorrectly rejected a later native MEDIUM request before HTTP dispatch. Original errors and calls are retained; proven controller or TLS-handshake failures do not consume effective attempts. Native effort adaptation is preserved. Stream-read failures not proven to be pure system faults are conservatively counted, as are actual deadlines and output exhaustion.

run_notes.zh: 本次测试流程已结束：39道初答中38份正常交卷；其他槽按实际最后有效尝试留证，MC可计独立核实的截止内容，未正常交卷的RMC／SMC为0。三轮自查固定保留，不以其他尝试或更大工作区补卷。
run_notes.en: The test process has ended, with38normal A1 finals out of39. Other slots retain their actual last effective attempt; MC may credit independently verified cutoff work, while nondelivery RMC/SMC are0. The three fixed self-check rounds are retained without cross-attempt unions or undelivered workspace supplementation.

RMC/SMC remain0. Operational timing and usage keep the actual last failure; all attempts are preserved without a cross-attempt union.
